theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_bc_ct_uniform_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (z : Euclid P) (r Λ : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ closedBall z (2 * r) → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → T.massOn (ball z (2 * r)) ≠ ∞ → ∃ δ Γ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ b ∈ closedBall z r, ∀ x' ∈ ball b δ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → T.massOn (ball x' ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Γ * ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
